subject: Mythology
title: Parvati: The Devoted Wife
description: A quick win: understand Parvati: The Devoted Wife.

hook.text: Parvati wanted to marry Shiva, but he was deep in meditation and refused to notice any living being.

buildup.text: She performed extreme penance for years, standing in freezing water and sitting in fire to prove her devotion.

discovery.text: Shiva tested her by disguising himself and insulting his own character. She defended him passionately every time.

twist.text: Impressed by her strength, Shiva married her. Together they became the model of divine partnership in Hinduism.

climax.text: Parvati is considered the source of Durga, Kali, and all other goddess forms — gentle and fierce combined.

punchline.text: She won the heart of a god by being more stubborn than he was.

quiz.question: How did Parvati eventually win Shiva's attention?
options: She defeated him in a contest of divine powers
She performed years of extreme penance to prove her devotion
The other gods convinced Shiva to marry her
